dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You have a lot of confidence in yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Yusuf
dialogues.text: This isn't pride talking. It is a fact.

dialogues.speaker: Yusuf
dialogues.text: At such a young age, I am already so capable! I can support myself!

dialogues.speaker: Yusuf
dialogues.text: I work for Ms. Sulaykha. I do the daily registration every day, and get my pay at the end of the day.

dialogues.speaker: Yusuf
dialogues.text: If I keep doing this, I'll get paid for life, and I can eat Uncle Lambad's fish rolls every day.

dialogues.speaker: Yusuf
dialogues.text: Thank you! I think so too.

dialogues.speaker: Yusuf
dialogues.text: Of course! You may not know this, but Ms. Sulaykha is a real genius. She was invited to study at Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Yusuf
dialogues.text: She rejected those block-headed adults, though. She said, and I quote, "Learning is no fun compared to making money."

dialogues.speaker: Yusuf
dialogues.text: Ms. Sulaykha also told me that the biggest secret to building wealth is to "stay away from the Kalimi Exchange."

dialogues.speaker: Yusuf
dialogues.text: A genius boss with a caring heart. I should have enough to last me for life!

dialogues.speaker: Yusuf
dialogues.text: I could eat them every day. You tell me if they're good or not.

dialogues.speaker: Yusuf
dialogues.text: Try them yourself if you don't believe me! Lambad's original fish roll will knock your socks off!
